facts.business: Pudumjee Paper Products Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of paper products.

auditor.name: SIUT & Co LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Intercorporate Loans - outstanding balance of Rs 9.45 crores as of March 31, 2026 (original disbursed principal: Rs 20 crores) from an unlisted corporate entity at 15% p.a. interest, secured by charge over specific real estate premises. Frequent maturity extensions (latest up to June 30, 2026), persistent interest servicing delays (normal interest outstanding Rs 1.08 crores since July 2025), and management's decision not to levy/recognise penal interest of 2% per month on delayed payments. Management classified loan as not SICR but 'considered good' with nil ECL provision based on collateral sufficiency.

key_risks: Intercorporate loan recoverability risk with frequent maturity extensions and interest servicing delays
Credit risk evaluation and expected credit loss provisioning uncertainty
Global trade policy uncertainty and tariff shocks
Currency volatility (rupee depreciation of 9.88% in FY26)
Elevated energy prices and subsidy pressures on government spending
facts.related_party_note: Intercorporate loan of Rs 9.45 crores (original principal Rs 20 crores) to an unlisted corporate entity secured by charge over real estate premises owned by the Borrower's directors and relatives of such directors. Interest rate 15% p.a. Normal interest outstanding Rs 1.08 crores as of balance sheet date (since July 2025). Penal interest rights of 2% per month on delayed payments not levied/recognised by management on prudent basis. Tenure extended up to June 30, 2026 by Investment and Borrowing Committee.
